name: critical
description: Do first. Wrong answers, real exposure, or work blocked until it lands.

name: high
description: Do next. A real defect, bounded today by something written down.

name: medium
description: Do eventually. Worth doing; nothing is wrong while it waits.

name: human
description: The task is marked for to work on. Should also be marked "do not automate".

name: do not automate
description: Do not automate this ask before discussion with a human.

name: template
description: A blank structure to copy, not a task to work — never automated

name: blocked: no paid plan
description: Needs a paid tier this project will not buy — see #64. Permanently blocked, not pending.

name: postmortem
description: A record of an incident: what happened, why, and what changed

name: re-review
description: Add to run the code and security reviews once more. The workflow removes it when they finish.

name: aia1
description: Step 1 — Assisted: the verification loop, and what it costs

name: aia2
description: Step 2 — Parallel: orchestration and review at scale

name: aia3
description: Step 3 — Supervised autonomy: agents at scale, loops and routines

name: aia4
description: Step 4 — AI-native: steering by intent, monitoring by exception
